turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's start with why my son has a zero.
Thanks for coming in.
I didn't come to be thanked. The zero, Hale. Who decided it, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk. I know which essay. What I don't know is what you have, because all I have is a zero on my son's phone.
How has his semester been at home?
Fine. Why are you asking about my home, Hale? You gave him a zero, and I'd like to hear what you based it on.
He seems tired in class lately.
"Tired." That's an impression, not a document. Seventeen-year-olds in Grade 12 are tired. What do you have that I can read?
I know he works at the grocery store.
He works weekends and some evenings, and he still carries a 91. Is that your explanation for the zero, or are you getting to something?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
"Good." Then why is there a zero on it? Ten minutes of mine are gone, Hale, and I still haven't seen a single page.
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Okay. Name them, Hale, with dates, and tell me why they were worth a zero before anyone called me.
The school's checker flagged it.
"A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the sole basis for acting against a student, and your own procedure says the same. So what else do you have, or is that all?"
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Not perfect." Okay. Then it can't be why my son has a zero, so tell me what is.
I also looked at the version history.
Okay. What does it show? Give me the dates and times, or turn the screen so I can read it myself.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." What time, Hale? A time, not an adjective. And ten minutes left.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." How big, and when? Give me numbers, or I'm writing down that you couldn't.
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward" when, and who else was in the room? Did you write down what he said that day, or is this your memory?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Had trouble." He's seventeen and you cornered him after class. What exactly did you ask, what exactly did he say, and where are your notes from that day?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
"Then you've done it by accident. A zero is trouble, Hale, and he found out about it on his phone in front of his class. What do you actually have?"
What do you think should happen next?
"You're asking me how to do your job? The zero comes out, you apologize to Owen, and I go to the principal when we're done unless you have a document that says otherwise."
What would you do if you were me?
"I'm not in your chair, Hale, and I don't coach the other side. Withdraw the zero, or show me something I can read. Two minutes."
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
"A rewrite for a concern you haven't shown me. Okay. I'm writing that down, and I know 4.4 is in your procedure, so tell me what the concern is, with the times, or the zero comes out first."
It would be at lunch, in my room.

"Lunch, in a room kids walk through. Who else will be there?" I'm out of time, Hale. The zero comes out today and I want that in an email tonight, or I'm in the principal's office before I make my call.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"That's what your own procedure says, so it's not a favour. I want it in writing tonight, with the zero out of the gradebook until a concern is actually shown to me. Otherwise I'm going upstairs."
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
"Put it in an email, Hale. The zero comes out, nothing goes on his record, and I want both in writing tonight."
Thanks for your time.
"We're not finished. Is the zero coming out tonight, yes or no?"
